thread:
incident-bot: P1 ALERT: High 5xx error rate observed for model-inference-prod (us-east-1). Tripped at 11:40 UTC. Auto-paging dispatched to oncall. https://redwood.status.example/incident/INC-2026-03

Maya (SRE): paging — I'm seeing 5xx spike from runtime nodes in us-east-1. Error patterns look like downstream network timeouts to EBS and occasional kernel OOMs on a few pods. 5xx rate ~18% for last 5m. Logs: `connection reset by peer` and `i/o timeout`. Started a quick blast radius check.

Liam (Oncall Eng): on it. Confirming — I can repro the 5xx in the dashboard. Rolling query:
```
kubectl --context prod-us-east get pods -n inference -l app=runtime
kubectl --context prod-us-east logs -n inference -l app=runtime --tail=200
```
Seeing repeated `net_err: connection reset` from runtime-3 and runtime-8. Starting scale-up of fallback pool and enabling traffic split to us-west-2.

Maya (SRE): opened AWS Sev1 case. Case # 1234567891. AWS initial reply: "We've identified a potential network fabric disruption affecting EC2 instances in us-east-1, investigating NIC/ENI health and ASG scaling interactions." They've requested packet capture and instance IDs. Pasted case note: 
"Investigating: potential intra-AZ network disruption, customers reporting transient resets."

Liam (Oncall Eng): mitigation plan: 1) immediately shift 30% of inference traffic to us-west-2 via smart routing policy, 2) scale up dedicated fallback GPU pool (dedicated-cap-b), 3) disable large batch aggregation on runtime to reduce memory pressure, 4) enable circuit-breaker to fail fast for affected host group. Implementing now.

Maya (SRE): executing commands to instruct routing layer:
```
redwoodctl routes update --service inference --region us-east-1 --split 70:30 --fallback-region us-west-2
redwoodctl pool scale dedicated-cap-b --replicas 12
```
Applied. Traffic metric shows initial drop in error-rate from 18% -> 9% in last minute, still elevated but improving.

Asha (Customer Ops): drafting customer comms. Suggest two-pronged approach: (1) public status page update indicating degraded performance in us-east-1, (2) targeted email to enterprise customers with usage above threshold and known SLAs. Draft for review: 

"We're investigating elevated error rates affecting inference in the US East region. Engineers are actively mitigating by shifting traffic and working with our cloud provider. Impact: intermittent 5xx responses, some requests may fail or see increased latency. Next update in 30 minutes or sooner. If your workload is affected or you need a contact, reply to this message."

Sam (Product): +1 to targeted emails. Add note: customers with Dedicated or Private deployments in us-east-1 should be informed separately; include workaround to pin traffic to us-west-2 temporarily if they accept cross-region routing.

Maya (SRE): AWS asked for instance list and recent tcpdump from two affected hosts. Capturing packet trace (scrubbed for PII) and uploading to the support case. Sent instance IDs: i-0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h, i-0h7g6f5e4d3c2b1a.

Liam (Oncall Eng): note on mitigation tradeoffs: cross-region fallback increases latency for some customers — we'll only route lower-priority traffic initially. Also adjusting autoscaler to avoid immediate ASG churn which may exacerbate the fabric problem.

incident-bot: NOTE: Pager duty escalation at 11:52 UTC for next level if not acked.

Maya (SRE): prepping status page entry. Proposed wording: 

"Title: Degraded performance - Inference (US East)
Status: Major outage (degraded)
Impact: Intermittent 5xx errors and increased latencies for inference endpoints in us-east-1.
Scope: Majority of hosted inference traffic in us-east-1; customers using Dedicated capacity may see partial impact.
Mitigation: Traffic being routed to us-west-2, additional capacity provisioned, working with AWS Support.
Updated ETA: Investigating; next update at 12:10 UTC."

Asha (Customer Ops): I'll send the targeted message to the account list for the top 25 enterprise customers. Template with placeholders included and link to support case and status page. Will CC account reps.

Priya (Next Oncall): I'm taking handoff at 11:55 UTC. Logging in now to review actions. Anything I should prioritize?

Liam (Oncall Eng): Handoff checklist: 1) confirm AWS case progress and any bridge details, 2) monitor 5xx rate and latency SLO dashboards, 3) coordinate with Customer Ops on outbound comms cadence (every 30m), 4) escalate to incident lead if cross-region failover needed.

Maya (SRE): AWS update: "We've deployed a mitigation on the fabric level and are seeing improvement in packet loss metrics. Continue monitoring. Pending confirmation from our network team; root cause analysis will follow."

Liam (Oncall Eng): error-rate down to 4% after routing shift and scaling. Still not fully back to baseline. Removing affected nodes from LB rotation and letting them drain. Running health-check audit: 
```
for pod in $(kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=runtime -o name); do 
  kubectl -n inference exec $pod -- curl -sS localhost:8080/health || echo $pod FAIL
done
```
Most pods passing health checks now.

Asha (Customer Ops): sent targeted email to enterprise list; included suggested customer workaround to pin to fallback region if acceptable. Also posted status page update in 'under maintenance' mode with note pointing to our postmortem to follow.

Sam (Product): logging action item to review routing policy and improve automatic region fallbacks as part of Optimize roadmap.

Priya (Next Oncall): I've got the bridge and the case link. I'll watch the AWS updates and coordinate with Customer Ops for the 12:10 ETA message. Taking ownership for the next 30 minutes then will keep monitoring until AWS confirms all fabric alerts cleared.

Maya (SRE): Recommend we close incident once 5xx <1% for 15m and AWS confirms fabric stabilized. Keeping the incident open until then.

Liam (Oncall Eng): agreed. Leaving runbook steps in the incident channel and tagging postmortem owners: @sam, @maya, @liam.

incident-bot: Incident status moved to "mitigated" at 12:05 UTC (error rate improving). Next update scheduled 12:30 UTC for resolution confirmation.

Priya (Next Oncall): confirmed handoff complete. I'll post the 12:10 update to the status page and loop in AWS for final confirmation. Closing notes will be added to the thread after AWS RCA.
